part.text:
The `TokenTypesTest` failure is pre-existing (it fails on the clean checkout too — unrelated to this change).

**Fix** in `javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/Node.java` (`PostOrderIterator.next()`): when the stack is empty (i.e., the root has no children and only the root remains to be visited), return the root and mark the iterator exhausted instead of calling `nodesStack.peek()`, which threw `EmptyStackException`.

Validation: `NodeTest` (including `PostOrderIteratorTest.rootHasNoChild`) now passes, and the full `javaparser-core-testing` suite shows no new failures (2335 tests, only the pre-existing unrelated failure).
